This website is run by {legalName(b)}, {b ? b.address.replace(/\s*\n\s*/g, ", ") : "Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia"}. We handle your personal data in line with Malaysia's Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (PDPA).

We don't sell or rent your personal data. We only send you promotions if you've asked to receive them, and you can stop them any time.

Under the PDPA you can ask to see the personal data we hold about you, correct it, or withdraw your consent to us using it (which may mean we can't fulfil an order). Contact us {b?.email && ( <> {" "} at {b.email} )}{" "} and we'll respond within 21 days.
